## Why This Is Asked

Tests understanding of practical software supply chain security at a beginner level, focusing on image provenance and incident response in a Kubernetes-based deployment.

## Key Concepts

- Image signing with Cosign
- Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
- CI gates for artifact policy
- Kubernetes admission controls
- Incident response playbooks and forensics

## Code Example

```javascript
# Sign an image with Cosign
cosign sign ghcr.io/org/service:tag --key cosign.key

# Verify and SBOM generation (conceptual)
cosign verify --certificate cosign.pub ghcr.io/org/service:tag
syft ghcr.io/org/service:tag -o spdx | gzip > sbom.spdx.json.gz

# GitHub Actions snippet (signing step as JS-annotated placeholder)
name: Image signing
on: [push]
jobs:
  sign:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Sign image
        run: cosign sign ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }} --key ${{ secrets.COSIGN_KEY }}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- What trade-offs arise from strict image signing in CI for deployment velocity?
- How would you adapt this plan for offline builds or multi-tenant environments?
